name: Ankle Bounce Against the Clock
setup: Stand tall on the balls of the feet, knees nearly straight, arms loose.
cues: Count clean reps in the time; a rep that is not clean does not count.
Tiny bounces off the floor, an inch high, light and quick.
Touch the floor and leave it fast, like the floor is hot.

faults.fix: Bounce off the floor with the knees nearly straight; do not squat into it.
Stay on the balls of the feet, quiet on every contact.
